categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in real estate agency and brokerage services, focusing on pre-sale houses, new houses, remaining houses, land, offices, and parking spaces. It also engages in real estate development through subsidiaries and strategic partners, investing in residential buildings, commercial spaces, and office buildings. The core business is real estate agency services, with expanding operations across northern, central, and southern Taiwan.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs integrated marketing strategies including market research, product planning, advertising design, and sales execution. It utilizes digital marketing, big data analytics, AI-assisted pricing models, and CRM systems to optimize customer targeting and sales conversion. The company also incorporates ESG principles and low-carbon design strategies in product packaging to enhance sustainability and market competitiveness.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are domestic real estate buyers including first-time homebuyers, upgraders, and investors. The company serves real estate developers by providing comprehensive marketing and sales services. The market coverage includes major metropolitan areas and emerging redevelopment zones in Taiwan, with a focus on residential and commercial real estate sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations cover the entire Taiwan region, with strong presence in the six major metropolitan areas (Taipei, New Taipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, Tainan, and Kaohsiung). The company also targets technology park areas and emerging redevelopment districts, ensuring balanced regional market penetration across northern, central, and southern Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the real estate supply chain, acting as an intermediary between real estate developers (upstream) and end buyers (downstream). It provides integrated marketing, sales, and brokerage services, and is expanding upstream into real estate development and investment activities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include digital transformation, innovative marketing, and differentiated service offerings to strengthen competitive advantage. The company invests in AI and big data analytics for precise market segmentation and pricing strategies. It also emphasizes ESG integration, sustainable development, and enhancing customer experience through multi-channel digital platforms and CRM systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through real estate agency and brokerage service fees, including commission from property sales and marketing services. Additional income derives from real estate development projects, rental income from commercial properties, and related real estate investment activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the leading real estate agency and brokerage firm in Taiwan, holding the largest market share with a balanced nationwide presence. Major competitors include New Lian Yang and Jia Shan Lin groups. The company differentiates itself through comprehensive marketing capabilities, strong brand reputation, and extensive regional coverage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the most recent fiscal year, consolidated revenue reached approximately NT$10.16 billion, a 31% increase year-over-year, with net profit after tax of NT$2.39 billion, up 37%. The company has shown strong growth momentum and maintains a robust financial structure with total assets exceeding NT$42.8 billion and equity of NT$10.6 billion. It continues to expand its capital base and invest in development projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a full-service integrated marketing and sales platform combining market research, product planning, digital marketing, and customer relationship management. It leverages advanced AI and big data tools to deliver precise customer targeting and efficient sales conversion. Its commitment to ESG and sustainable development enhances product appeal and market differentiation, while its extensive regional network ensures broad market access and client trust.
